summary: This sermon concludes a series on Ephesians 2:10, emphasizing that every believer is created in Christ Jesus for unique good works that God has prepared in advance. Using a puzzle illustration, the pastor argues that each Christian has an irreplaceable part to play in revealing God's character and advancing His kingdom to a watching world.
key_points: Every believer is called into ministry, not just pastors or church leaders
Past failures and brokenness do not disqualify you; God uses our weakness for His purposes
Good works serve as specific revelation, demonstrating God's character and proclaiming the gospel through actions and words
Discovering your good works involves examining your personality, opportunities, spiritual gifts, listening prayer, and seeking godly counsel
We are individual puzzle pieces forming a collective masterpiece that displays the kingdom of God
big_idea: God has created every believer in Christ Jesus with a unique set of good works prepared in advance, and together we form a collective masterpiece that reveals His character and advances His kingdom to the world.
title: For Good Works
